scope: Application/systems AI engineering; CS329Z Fall2026 and application-relevant CS336 Spring2026 material

findings.title_zh: 无框架内核到框架抽象
findings.title_en: From a plain harness to framework abstractions
findings.gap_zh: 已有循环与 harness 主题，实验未明确要求先独立实现再迁移。
findings.gap_en: Loops/harnesses existed; labs did not clearly require an independent implementation before migration.
findings.evidence_zh: L13：同一任务的显式循环、工具协议、预算与故障夹具，再迁移到框架并比较。
findings.evidence_en: L13:explicit loop,tool protocol,budget and fault fixtures,then migrate the same task and compare.

findings.title_zh: 数据策展与优化数据链
findings.gap_zh: 去重与数据飞轮散在多处，缺少独立的数据选择、合成验证和配比实践。
findings.gap_en: Deduplication/flywheels were scattered; selection,synthesis verification and mixing lacked a coherent practice.
findings.evidence_zh: L15：数据血缘、分组切分、近重复、合成筛选、数据消融。 检查成功轨迹中的投机/冗余，并保留有用途的失败步骤。
findings.evidence_en: L15:lineage,grouped splits,near duplicates,synthetic filtering and data ablation. Inspect successful traces for exploits/redundancy and retain useful labeled failed steps.

findings.title_zh: 环境任务与验证器正确性
findings.gap_zh: 四元组已有；oracle、负例、替代正确解、环境与评分器故障尚未串成完整验收。
findings.gap_en: The4-tuple existed;oracle,negative/alternative solutions and environment/grader failures lacked an integrated acceptance exercise.
findings.evidence_zh: L14：可重建任务包，验证已知正负例，再保留所有独立试次与轨迹。
findings.evidence_en: L14:rebuildable task,known positive/negative checks,all independent attempts and traces.

findings.title_zh: 重复运行与评分器校验
findings.gap_zh: pass@k/pass^k 已有术语，需补不同事件、估计分母、相关试次与误判。
findings.gap_en: pass@k/pass^k were named;event definitions,denominators,dependence and grader errors needed depth.
findings.evidence_zh: 报告 k/n、全部结果、失败分类和 grader 挑战集；区分多候选成功与连续可靠。
findings.evidence_en: Reportk/n,all outcomes,failure classes and grader challenges;separate candidate success from consistency.

findings.gap_zh: 已有模型卡和业务指标，缺少模型级评测的可比性与迁移判断。
findings.gap_en: Model cards/business metrics existed;model-level comparability and transfer decisions lacked structure.
findings.evidence_zh: 选型卡：同一任务/工具/预算比较，区分模型、harness 和评分方式的影响。
findings.evidence_en: Selection card:matched tasks/tools/budgets,separating model,harness and scoring effects.

findings.gap_zh: 有显存与 GPU 术语，缺少内存分账、算术强度与估算—测量闭环。
findings.gap_en: Memory/GPU concepts existed;accounting,arithmetic intensity and estimate/measure loops needed depth.
findings.evidence_zh: 资源预算表：权重/KV/激活等，理论上界、实测和误差解释；L07/L09。

findings.title_zh: 测试时计算与验证预算
findings.gap_zh: 路由、重试和协作已有，尚无跨策略的计算分配单元。
findings.gap_en: Routing,retries and collaboration existed without a dedicated compute-allocation unit.
findings.evidence_zh: 同预算比较单次、候选/验证和分解策略，检查错误验证器如何放大失败。
findings.evidence_en: Budget-match one-shot,candidate/verification and decomposition;inspect amplified verifier errors.

findings.gap_zh: 事实生命周期较完整，经验巩固、分层管理和过度个性化需展开。
findings.gap_en: Fact lifecycle was strong;consolidation,tiering and over-personalization needed depth.
findings.evidence_zh: 可撤回经验跨场景测试；固定上下文预算分别看写入、检索和任务结果。
findings.evidence_en: Test retractable experience across scenarios,with separate writes,retrieval and task results.

findings.gap_zh: 工具注册与发现已有，目录扩大后的候选召回和权限过滤尚未成体系。
findings.gap_en: Registration/discovery existed;large-catalog retrieval and authorization filtering lacked a dedicated exercise.
findings.evidence_zh: 对照全目录注入与授权内检索，测召回、误选、参数和成本。
findings.evidence_en: Compare full injection with authorized retrieval;measure recall,selection,arguments and cost.

findings.gap_zh: 已有 DSPy 与 GEPA/MIPRO，需要明确输入数据、反馈、搜索预算和隔离测试。
findings.gap_en: DSPy/GEPA/MIPRO existed;inputs,feedback,search budgets and held-out tests needed explicit treatment.
findings.evidence_zh: 一次可复算的提示/示例优化，保存候选、费用、独立测试与负结果。
findings.evidence_en: One reproducible prompt/example optimization with candidates,costs,held-out tests and negative results.

findings.title_zh: RL 与蒸馏的实验正确性
findings.gap_zh: 算法名覆盖较全，rollout/训练版本、归一化、loss reduction 与异步数据偏移需补齐。
findings.gap_en: Algorithm coverage was broad;rollout/training revisions,normalization,reduction and stale data needed depth.
findings.evidence_zh: L12 先检查奖励解析与策略版本，再比较 SFT/RL 或蒸馏；数学 RLVR 结果与 Agent 任务分别验证。
findings.evidence_en: L12 checks reward parsing/policy revisions before comparisons;validate math RLVR and agent tasks separately.

findings.title_zh: 端到端威胁模型与安全评测
findings.title_en: End-to-end threat modeling and safety evaluation
findings.gap_zh: 已有权限、沙箱和注入，缺少工具链组合风险、合适披露与误拦截/可用性联合检查。
findings.gap_en: Permissions,isolation/injection existed;composed-tool risk,appropriate disclosure and utility/false-block evaluation needed integration.
findings.evidence_zh: 完整作品的威胁图、正常/恶意任务、攻击复现、修复和上线风险验收。
findings.evidence_en: Product threat model,benign/adversarial tasks,reproduction,repair and release-risk acceptance.

findings.title_zh: 代码 Agent 与 ACI 选修
findings.gap_zh: 终端接口已有；仓库定位、patch、测试和重放可作为平台方向扩展。
findings.gap_en: Terminal interfaces existed;localization,patches,tests and replay form a platform elective.
findings.evidence_zh: 小型离线修复任务，比较工具观察格式；11 月 30 日课程尚未授课。
findings.evidence_en: Small offline repair with interface comparison;the30 November lecture is upcoming.

findings.gap_zh: 事件触发、打扰成本、纠正推断和用户控制可作为后续产品方向。
findings.gap_en: Event triggers,interruption costs,correctable inferences and controls form a product extension.
findings.evidence_zh: 模拟事件的误触发/去重/撤销实验；12 月 2 日课程尚未授课，使用已公开论文。
findings.evidence_en: Simulated false-trigger/deduplication/revocation;the2 December class is upcoming,use the published paper.

findings.title_zh: 阶段作品、口试与同行复核
findings.gap_zh: 已有最终评审，需把 proposal、基线、中期 demo 和评测复核放进学习过程。
findings.gap_en: Final review existed;proposal,baseline,midpoint demo and evaluation review needed explicit milestones.
findings.evidence_zh: 每个项目保留中期 review 与最终独立复现，现场解释和修改实现。
findings.evidence_en: Retain midpoint review and final independent reproduction,with explanation and a live change.

findings.gap_zh: 模块依赖把完整 RAG、模型原理或本地服务放到部分无关路径之前。
findings.gap_en: Module prerequisites unnecessarily blocked some paths on full RAG,theory or local serving.
findings.evidence_zh: 112 单元先修 DAG 与四条自动展开路线；API 路线不依赖 SFT、GPU 服务或多 Agent 工程。
findings.evidence_en: 112-unit DAG and4 expanded routes;the API path excludes SFT,GPU serving and multi-agent engineering.
